listing.aiSummary: Provides Python scripts for modifying game files and collecting data.

description: Offers a collection of Python scripts designed to modify game configuration files directly. Includes tools for adjusting faction doctrines and ship sizes, as well as a script that scans for hull styles to assist with mod compatibility whitelists.
